judgments.label: true_positive
judgments.rationale: All three links in this fixed share bar (Facebook, WhatsApp, Pinterest sharers) carry aria-label="compartilhe" and contain only an SVG brand icon with no title or name, so each link's accessible name is just "compartilhe" ('share'). The only programmatic context is the list/listitem and a sibling div reading "compartilhe", which names none of the services; the live page (checked 2026-10-11) has the same markup. Sighted users tell the links apart by the logos, but a screen-reader user hears three identical 'compartilhe' links that open three different services and cannot tell which is which, so the purpose of each link is not determinable from its text plus programmatic context, a 2.4.4 failure as the finding says (it is also arguably a 1.1.1 gap, since the label does not convey what the icon shows). This is the Facebook sharer link (icon-facebook); suggested name 'Compartilhar no Facebook' fits.
